verdict.rationale: Ramp Intelligence and MCP/CLI capabilities let users query spend data conversationally and receive AI-generated recommendations (recommended approval actions, anomaly flagging, top-vendor analysis, auto-coding of expenses) directly inside the product, backed by both docs and live probes confirming a working MCP server. missing for 10: independent third-party reviews or user testimonials validating insight quality/accuracy in real-world use, beyond vendor-provided examples.
